name: Write In For Love
source:
Is it unethical to lie to get a job? Sure. Is it illegal though? Maybe, you're not a lawyer, just a desperate writer. Oh and why is your ex around suddenly? Is this karma? Surely not right?

[From [url=https://carziecat.itch.io/write-in-for-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了找工作撒谎是不道德的吗？当然。但这违法吗？也许，你不是律师，只是一个绝望的作家。哦，为什么你的前任突然出现？这就是业力吗？肯定不对吧？

[来自[url=https://carziecat.itch.io/write-in-for-love]itch.io[/url]]
